# Microsoft Teams Rooms: OAuth 2.0 and Microsoft 365 SMTP AUTH

**Status: OAuth available**

Supported. For most installations this is a configuration change rather than a migration, and no relay is needed.

## What the vendor says

Microsoft's own product. Enable modern auth on the resource account - no relay needed.

[Read the vendor's statement in full](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/exchange/clients-and-mobile-in-exchange-online/deprecation-of-basic-authentication-exchange-online)  
Everything on this page comes from that document. If it and this page disagree, the vendor is right and this page is out of date — [say so](https://github.com/msgwing/ZeroSMTP/issues/new?template=device_report.yml).

## What to do

Follow the vendor's instructions above. Come back here only if the device turns out to be on an older firmware branch than the one the document assumes.
